purpose: Require a reader to revise what it thinks exists, then re-canonicalize affected relations before committing the new Fold.

events.text: Near the west arch, Nera watched a hooded courier place a blue token on the table. Later that hour, Nera called the courier Rowan.
Before sunset, Rowan returned to Nera and spoke about the blue token. Nera again referred to the hooded courier as Rowan.
At the next bell, Nera stood beside Rowan at the fountain while the hooded courier crossed the west arch behind them carrying another blue token.
Nera then learned that the courier was Iven, who had carried both blue tokens while Rowan had remained with her at the fountain.

globalInvariants: No earlier Fold changes when a later event is appended or changed.
Perception of a form does not itself grant beinghood.
A live identity hypothesis is not prematurely SYNed into proven sameness.
When event 3 defeats Rowan=courier, affected earlier relations are re-canonicalized before Fold3 commits.
The trajectory preserves that the reader once entertained Rowan=courier even after the current Fold rejects it.
